Configuration:
script: %dw 2.0
output application/json
var authHeader = attributes.headers.'authorization' default ""
var apikeyRaw = attributes.headers.'apikey' default ""
var useAuth = (authHeader != "")
var raw = if (useAuth) authHeader else apikeyRaw
var stripped = if ((raw startsWith "Bearer ") or (raw startsWith "bearer ")) (raw[7 to -1] default "") else raw
var parts = stripped splitBy ":"
var hasValidFormat = (sizeOf(parts) == 2) and (parts[0] != "") and (parts[1] != "")
var alreadyHasClientId = attributes.headers.'client_id'?
var alreadyHasClientSecret = attributes.headers.'client_secret'?
---
if (hasValidFormat and !alreadyHasClientId and !alreadyHasClientSecret)
  (if (useAuth) (attributes.headers - "authorization") else (attributes.headers - "apikey")) ++ {
    "client_id": parts[0],
    "client_secret": parts[1]
  }
else
  attributes.headers
requiresPayload: false
requestFlow: onRequest
